physicalNotes: Radius 0.27745609 Jupiter radii from Barone et al. 2025 (2025A&A...704A..41B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...704A..41B/abstract): 19,835.9 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Barone et al. 2025 (2025A&A...704A..41B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...704A..41B/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.01824884 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
